rows.name: Sonic Shot
rows.desc: Deals {rate:percent} ATK as sonic damage to a target enemy, plus {atkadd} bonus damage

rows.name: Healing Chord
rows.desc: Heals the caster and the ally with the lowest HP for {heal:percent} of the caster's Max HP, scaled by Energy Recharge, then randomly grants the whole team one of these buffs for {dur} seconds: +{atkup:percent} ATK, +{critdmg:percent} Crit DMG, or +{critrate:percent} Crit Rate.

rows.name: Resonance
rows.desc: Begins a performance, spreading rhythm from the caster for {dur} seconds. Allies within range gain +{critrate:percent} Crit Rate and +{critdmg:percent} Crit DMG. When an ally's HP drops below {threshold:percent}, heals all allies below {threshold:percent} HP for {heal:percent} of the caster's Max HP, up to once every 5 seconds. Requires {energy} Energy to cast.

rows.name: Shield Bash
rows.desc: Deals {rate:percent} ATK as shield bash damage to a target enemy, plus {atkadd} bonus damage

rows.name: Bulwark Field
rows.desc: Deploys a shield field, dealing {rate:percent} ATK damage to nearby enemies and slowing their movement by {slow:percent} for {slowtime} seconds

rows.name: Immovable
rows.desc: Enters a guarding stance, restoring {healrate:percent} of Max HP and striking nearby enemies for {rate:percent} ATK damage

rows.name: Harmony
rows.desc: While on the battlefield, all allies gain +{energy:percent} Energy Recharge and +{damage:percent} Damage Bonus.

rows.name: Guard Instinct
rows.desc: Raises own DEF by {defup:percent} when HP falls below {threshold:percent}

rows.name: Melee Strike
rows.desc: Deals {rate:percent} ATK plus {atkadd} as melee damage to a target enemy
